dogecoin.text: @ANNA86289546 hello Anna. You seem to be a cool person, and I like some of ideas about dogecoin.

@dogecoin_empire I'm surprised that there hasn't been a major song to come out on the charts to push dogecoin farther. Hopefully some popular musician can take the helm on it. Advertising would be massive, like a commercial on tv.

@dogelettuce I certainly didn't sell, and held even with the dip that happened. I see a lot of potential for growth with dogecoin. Power to the people, over these stupid hedge funds. I think there will be worldwide adoption within the coming years.

@ConanOBrien @MattWallace888 It's certainly has a lot of potential. Also it can be a means of adoption instead of fiat currency that is used today. Eventually we will see dogecoin with a worldwide use case such going to store and places to buy things in dogecoin.
@LloydOstertagg Absolutely it is the future of all currency. It replaces the fiat currency of earth. I think the more people use dogecoin, the more it becomes universally adopted.
@usssks I'm holding strong. Regardless of the dips, I remain loyal to Dogecoin.

Dogecoin has a lot of potential to grow and become adopted by so many places. Still Coinbase doesn't list it yet, Amazon would absolutely push it further for online payment,  restaurants and retail stores need to adopt as a form of payment.
@stevenmarkryan Absolutely yes, and everything else bought with dogecoin.

@Dogecoinxx Let's all buy and never sell. If whales never sale the price would be over 1 dollar by now. The problem is that there are too many paper hands that sell to make the price drop. No telling what the price would be if every single person bought a used dogecoin as the main currency.
